  "correction_rules": [
    "Model consistently overestimates prices in early periods (first 5-10 days) after market spikes, especially when sentiment is neutral or slightly positive.",
    "Model underestimates prices during prolonged downtrends, particularly when sentiment is negative or neutral, leading to persistent lag in price recovery.",
    "After sharp price spikes, model forecasts often overshoot by 5-15% in the immediate following days, especially when sentiment is positive (e.g., +0.50 or above).",
    "When sentiment is negative (e.g., -0.25 or below), model tends to underestimate true price movements, often missing downward corrections.",
    "Model exhibits mean reversion bias — overcorrects after strong upward moves, leading to premature price declines that don’t materialize.",
    "In the final 5-7 days of the forecast horizon, model tends to be overly conservative, underestimating upward momentum when sentiment is positive.",
    "Sentiment-driven corrections are often delayed by 1-3 days in model output — adjust forecasts by adding 0.1-0.3 to the forecast if sentiment is positive and 0.1-0.2 if negative."
  ]
}
